name: Crochet Bear
description: A classic, cuddly plush bear handcrafted with soft acrylic yarn. Features rounded ears and a timeless snout that make it a cozy gift.

name: Crochet Cheetah
description: Intricately detailed with hand-stitched spots and contrasting yarn accents. A unique, artisan plush perfect for lovers of wild cats.

name: Crochet Chicken
description: An adorable barnyard friend featuring a bright red comb and textured feather stitches. Compact, charming, and full of personality.

name: Crochet Cow
description: Stitched with classic black and white patches and cute little horns. Soft and squishy, making it a sweet addition to any plush collection.

name: Crochet Deer
description: Features delicate branched antlers and subtle embroidered spots along its back. Made with premium woodland-toned yarn for a gentle aesthetic.

name: Crochet Dragon
description: A detailed fantasy plush complete with stitched wings, textured scales, and tiny horns. Requires extra yarn and time, making it a true showstopper.

name: Crochet Elephant
description: Designed with oversized floppy ears and a curved trunk crafted from plush gray yarn. Huggable, sturdy, and wonderfully soft.

name: Crochet Fox
description: Handcrafted in vibrant burnt-orange yarn with a fluffy white-tipped tail and dark paws. A clever and cheerful companion.

name: Crochet Frog
description: Bright green and pocket-sized with big, expressive safety eyes. Quick to charm anyone looking for a fun desktop buddy.

name: Crochet Highland Cow
description: Made with extra fluffy, textured yarn to recreate a signature shaggy coat and long horns. A cozy favorite that takes extra yarn to make.

name: Crochet Lion
description: Features a full, hand-looped yarn mane that adds incredible texture and personality. Bold and kingly yet ultra-soft to hold.

name: Crochet Penguin
description: Chubby and cheerful with a smooth color-blocked belly and tiny orange feet. Crafted for maximum squishiness.

name: Crochet Pig
description: Stitched in soft pastel pink yarn with a prominent snout and curly little tail. Simple, sweet, and irresistible.

name: Crochet Tiger
description: Showcases intricate stripe detailing hand-embroidered across a rich orange body. A labor-intensive plush made with care.

name: Crochet Unicorn
description: Topped with a shimmering metallic horn and a colorful pastel yarn mane. Magical, whimsical, and crafted with specialty fibers.
